description: Header file defining classes and structures for CUDA symmetric memory management in distributed training, including resource wrappers, memory classes, peer info, and allocator interfaces.

classes.name: AllocationRef
classes.description: Resource wrapper owning a (vaddr, handle) pair, managing memory mapping and release.

classes.name: CUDAPeerAllocInfo
classes.description: Holds base pointers and signal pads for a group of peers sharing memory allocations.

classes.name: CUDASymmetricMemory
classes.description: Represents a symmetric memory segment with methods for buffer access and synchronization.

classes.name: CUDASymmetricMemoryAllocator
classes.description: Allocator class for managing CUDA symmetric memory allocations and rendezvous.

classes.name: Block
classes.description: Metadata for each allocation, including device info, size, and associated peer info.

methods.name: alloc
methods.description: Allocates memory of specified size on a given device, optionally within a group.

methods.name: free
methods.description: Frees the memory pointed to by the given pointer.

methods.name: get_alloc_size
methods.description: Returns the size of the allocation for a given pointer.

methods.name: rendezvous
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a symmetric memory object associated with a pointer and group.

methods.name: has_multicast_support
methods.description: Checks if multicast is supported on a specific device.

methods.name: supported_device_type
methods.description: Returns the device type supported by the allocator.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name of the allocator.
